title: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design
notes: Clear floor spaces may overlap each other and the turning space (305.2, 603.2.1); doors may not swing into any fixture's clear floor space or clearance (603.2.3), with exceptions for single-user rooms that this pack does not apply. Showers are taken as standard roll-in showers; a transfer shower's 36 × 48 in clearance differs.

zones.description: WC clearance 60 in (1525 mm) from the side wall by 56 in (1420 mm) from the rear wall; grab bars, dispensers and other fixtures' clear floor spaces may overlap it
30 × 48 in (760 × 1220 mm) clear floor space for a forward approach to a lavatory, 17 in of it in the knee and toe space under the lavatory
30 × 48 in (760 × 1220 mm) clear floor space for a forward approach to a urinal
Clearance 30 in (760 mm) wide along the whole length of a bathtub
Clearance 30 in (760 mm) wide along the open face of a standard roll-in shower

distances.description: WC centreline 16–18 in (405–455 mm) from the side wall or partition
